Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Price eligible retainer listings with Universalis and a configurable match or one-gil-undercut rule. Manage retainer ventures using the game's own retainer UI.
Punchline: Price listings and manage retainer ventures.
Changelog:
## 0.5.1.14

- Added a Status tab with timestamped messages, a failures-only filter, and copy controls. Operation changes, listing failures and Universalis diagnostics are also written to Dalamud logs. History keeps the latest 300 messages for the current session.

- Successful auto-update summaries now show green with COMPLETE, even when unavailable retainers were skipped.
